coherence.note: sum(attribution) / v(N). 1.0 means the factor values account for exactly the movement the decomposition explains. Shapley is 1.0 by the efficiency axiom; naive attribution double-counts shared credit and cannot be converted to rupees.

classification.note: Held-out CODES, not rows. The deterministic lookup was restricted to the training split, so every code scored here reached the model with nothing memorised. Small per-class support is real -- hence Wilson intervals rather than bare percentages.

error_decomposition.note: The model reads the ESTIMATED decomposition, not the truth. Splitting the error says whether the bottleneck is the model or the attribution feeding it.

root_cause.note: Exact match on root_cause_label against the injected cause. The model emits from the same closed enum the generator injects from, so this is forced-choice classification, not keyword matching.

healthy_merchants.note: Merchants with nothing injected. A model that never uses none_of_the_above here is overconfident.
